items.html: And these nine first Sefirot are called the head, which lies in the dust, for it is placed among the Klipot, in the secret of the dust of the Tabernacle. But her last aspect, called the tail, alone remained in Atzilut, and it is she who rules now, at the time of the exile. And therefore the nations of the world, which are the tail, have the upper hand in this exile, because they are nourished from the tail which rules now. But Israel, which is the head, is nourished from the head. And behold, the head lies in the dust, therefore Israel, in this exile, are subdued and low under the nations, which is called the tail.
